_about: Machine-readable merge tiers for ramseyer. Read by .github/scripts/agent_gate.py; the plain-language rules are in CONTRIBUTING.md. Changing this file is itself a tier 3 change. Patterns use fnmatch syntax against repository paths; the first matching rule wins. Tier 1: merges when checks pass and an independent agent review approves the current head. Tier 2: the same, and Espen is notified. Tier 3: only Espen merges (label espen-approved).
_trusted_note: Only comments and labels from these accounts count. Every Claude Code session posts as Espen's account through the 'claude' app; anyone can comment on a public repository, so this list is what stops outsiders from approving.
_agents_note: Claude Code only for now. A review must come through the 'claude' app and from a Claude Code session other than the PR's author session (Agent-Author line in the PR description). Codex or another agent can be added here later, by a tier 3 PR.
